input_policy.admitted_train: HWRT curated official train split + UJI Pen v2 official writer-disjoint train split
input_policy.heldout_comparison: HWRT curated test split + UJI Pen v2 official writer-disjoint test split; scored once after training
input_policy.project_owned: excluded from this student experiment and its comparison
input_policy.crohme: zero rows; never trained or scored

synthetic_rows.generator: two independently resampled HWRT train dashes, separated and lightly sloped; no CROHME or project holdout input

augmentation_audit.algorithm: orientation-preserving global affine jitter; no flips, stroke reorder, point deletion, or topology synthesis

image_sample_verification.legend: each symbol is shown as source ink then affine-augmented ink; captions show teacher Top1 before>after

augmentation_audit.qa_scope: training pool only; no augmentation parameter selection from heldout metrics
